name: Kagami no Hate no Rougoku
source:
Is what's reflected in the mirror a lie or the truth?

When the cherry blossoms fall.
The main cast of third-year middle schoolers hear a strange voice in the school compound one day.
When they follow the direction of the voice, they find a beautiful mirror.
The voice of a young boy saying, "Help me, help me".
As if inviting them in, the main cast is pulled into the mirror.
The sight they saw within was frightful enough to make them hold their breath.

It was the elementary school that should've been abandoned years ago...
Cowering in the place that shouldn't exist, they can't escape no matter what they do.

"I...committed a sin."

The owner of the voice they heard from the mirror was standing there.
Who is that boy?
Will they be able to escape?

The curtain rises on the stage dyed with fear and despair.

[Translated from the [url=https://kagahate-enmei.jimdofree.com/%E3%81%82%E3%82%89%E3%81%99%E3%81%98/]official website[/url]]
translation:
镜子里映出的到底是谎言还是真相？

当樱花飘落的时候。
某天，中学三年级的主要演员们在学校大院里听到了奇怪的声音。
当他们顺着声音的方向前进时，他们发现了一面美丽的镜子。
一个小男孩的声音说：“救救我，救救我”。
仿佛在邀请他们进来一样，主要演员被拉进镜子里。
里面的景象，足以让他们屏住呼吸。

这是多年前就该废弃的小学……
蜷缩在不该存在的地方，无论做什么都无法逃脱。

“我……犯了罪。”

从镜子里听到的声音的主人就站在那里。
那个男孩是谁？
他们能逃脱吗？

舞台上的帷幕升起，充满了恐惧和绝望。

[翻译自[url=https://kagahate-enmei.jimdofree.com/%E3%81%82%E3%82%89%E3%81%99%E3%81%98/]官网[/url]]
